conviction_note: Baseline median reaction is 15.1% (inflated by duplicated event rows) and this name has moved 13-18% on four of its last five real prints, so magnitude is large; I tilt negative because the stock ground down 22% in fifteen sessions on ordinary volume with no news, and it must be measured against an FY27 guide of 5-10% sales growth issued ten weeks after a quarter in which sales fell 24% YoY.

findings.finding: A monotone 22% slide from $12.89 on 2026-08-13 to $10.01 on 2026-09-03 on entirely ordinary volume (25k-67k shares a day against a 56.8k twenty-day average, no single distribution spike), in a name whose whole float turns over slowly - a persistent seller with no news event and no volume signature anywhere in the capture to explain it.
findings.corpus_ref: quote.json bars 2026-08-12 through 2026-09-03; filings.json shows no filing of any kind after 2026-08-14 to explain the move
findings.why_not_priced: A grind lower with no volume spike is invisible to news screens and to any preview: there is literally nothing in the capture between 2026-08-19 and the print - one Stocktwits message in eleven days. If this were a known catalyst the volume would have spiked on one day rather than distributing evenly across fifteen sessions. The direction of an informed seller in a 57k-share-a-day stock is information the tape carries and the wire does not.
findings.independence: The only late-arriving corpus item, a Stocktwits post dated 2026-09-01, independently reads the tape the same way ('will go down another 1.00 tomorrow before leveling off') - docs/15f873a41212159a193bec5557be83120edf088e.txt

findings.finding: On 2026-08-06 the company filed an 8-K with items 5.02, 7.01 and 9.01 adding Kevin D. Leary as an independent director onto the compensation and governance committees, accompanied the same evening by a Form 3 and a Form 4 from a brand-new filer CIK, and four days later on 2026-08-10 a SCHEDULE 13D/A was accepted - the exact filing signature of an activist board settlement or cooperation agreement, four weeks before the print.
findings.why_not_priced: The 13D/A body is not in the capture and got exactly one Stocktwits mention with no engagement; nothing aggregates the sequence 8-K/5.02 -> Form 3 -> 13D/A into a settlement read. If the market had priced a board settlement in a $130m-cap company with a $10m buyback authorisation and a publicly speculated SWBI combination, the stock would not have fallen 22% in the three weeks after it. That is what makes it a floor for a bad print rather than a reason to be long.
findings.independence: A December-2025 corpus item names Engine Capital Management as the largest fund holder of AOUT ($8m position), an activist manager, which is consistent with the 13D/A being an activist rather than a passive filing - docs/994d48dabaeeaa94ab9820db27a79d7711cb5465.txt

findings.finding: The FY27 guide the company must defend on this print - net sales of $200-210m, 5-10% growth, adjusted EBITDA up over 40% - was issued on 2026-06-25 in the same release that reported Q4 FY26 sales of $47.06m, down 24.03% YoY, and the comparable seasonal quarter a year earlier (Q1 FY26, printed 2025-09-04) collapsed to $29.7m from $41.6m and took the stock down 18%.
findings.why_not_priced: The guidance range itself is wire copy. What is not aggregated is the arithmetic tension: a +5-10% full-year growth guide sitting on top of a most-recent quarter that shrank 24%, with the first quarter of the guided year being the smallest and historically most disappointing quarter of the fiscal calendar. There is zero sell-side preview in this capture (n_queries=0 in every one of six sweeps), so nobody in the observed corpus has done that arithmetic.
findings.independence: The FY26 experience is a separate document within the same body: the company withdrew its FY26 guide at the 2025-06-26 print after retailers pulled forward $8-10m of orders, so a mid-year guidance withdrawal is an established pattern at this issuer - https://d-risk.ai/AOUT/10-K/2026-06-25

baseline_tension: My tape finding agrees with the run-up (-20.2% over 20 days) and with the historically negative Q1 reaction; the activist-settlement finding cuts against it, which is why the net number is well inside the 15% median magnitude.
corpus_limits: No option chain, so no implied move or skew. The baseline's event_plausibility verdict is 'unknown' because duplicated event rows halve the inferred cadence to 69 days; the underlying dates (2026-06-26, 2026-03-12, 2025-12-09, 2025-09-05, 2025-06-27) are in fact a normal quarterly cadence, so I treated the reaction history as usable while noting the median is overstated by the duplicates.
